##### Project general facts

Minori is a boutique complex of eleven contemporary European-style villas, developed by Eco Invest Group with over a decade of experience. Located on pink-zone land with a long-term prepaid lease structure, this exclusive project blends thoughtful architecture, a private spa zone, and professional management focused on stable returns. Designed around the core principles of safety, serenity, and a sense of home, Minori offers a rare opportunity to invest in a fully furnished, turnkey property in one of Bali’s most proven, high-demand locations — with full flexibility of use, whether for personal living, rental income, or a combination of both, without restrictions on residency.

Residents enjoy a wealth of amenities designed for comfort and connection. Every villa features a private pool with a designated kids' area, spacious bedrooms, private terraces, and high-quality eco-friendly materials. The complex offers a shared swimming pool with sun loungers, a lounge area with BBQ, and a premium spa zone right inside the community. Family-centric services include a shuttle to schools and beaches, babysitting, a mobile kids' room, concierge, and an in-house delivery kitchen. A gated, curated community environment ensures privacy and exclusivity, while supporting a mixed-use lifestyle tailored to both long-term living and short-term stays.

Every villa at Minori is delivered fully equipped with premium appliances, furniture, and decor. The interior concept blends European elegance with Asian harmony, featuring soft minimalism in warm beige tones, natural wood, and stone textures. Large sliding panoramic windows open directly to gardens and pools, erasing the line between indoor comfort and greenery. Spacious living areas feature cozy seating with an artificial fireplace and TV zone. Bedrooms offer direct terrace access, personal storage, and TV areas with audio systems, creating calm, harmonious sanctuaries designed equally for everyday living and high-quality rental appeal.

##### Parking

Shared parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in the Legian area of Seminyak, this exceptional location places residents in one of Bali's most established and consistently top-performing districts. Seminyak has long held leading positions in rental returns and property value growth, supported by mature infrastructure, convenient access to the international airport, and limited supply. This ensures stable demand, high liquidity, and minimal risks compared to newer, still-developing areas.

The location is distinguished by its unique pocket of calm just steps from Sunset Road. Residents enjoy the full spectrum of the district's infrastructure, supermarkets, restaurants, shopping areas, cafes, branded hotels, fitness clubs, yoga studios, pharmacies, spas, kids' centers, and a shopping mall, all within easy reach, yet away from noise and tourist traffic. World-class beach clubs, iconic temples, a top-ranked golf course, and wellness centers are just minutes away.

For those seeking a residence that embodies both urban convenience and secluded tranquility, Legian delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of proven investment fundamentals, mature amenities, and easy access to Bali's finest attractions makes it one of the island's most desirable addresses. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of Bali, calm, connected and effortlessly sophisticated.
